items.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: We did the Faure “Pavane” kind of in the style of a Bill Evans with a symphony orchestra record.

ctx.x: Yeah sometimes you get those things like they’re in the key of B and you’re thinking oh my licks, I don’t know if I can play those in C sharp.

Well they’re certainly not as easy to do, you just reminded me, recently I did a session for Robby Krieger of the Doors. He’s still around. He’s got a beautiful recording studio in Glendale, and I was called. He wanted me to play on something. In the middle of this tune it was sort of like a tribute to Bill — I don’t know what the thing was, but anyway it was a jazz based lyric although it was a rock & roll tune for sure. But he said something about, “Well play ‘Remember Bird’” or something like that, and then…
I’d like to talk about that later if we get back to it. But continue — so you go in the booth and Lou is there. Is Carole King there?
